overview: A lightweight leave-management system with two backend microservices and one frontend. The leave-service handles all leave request CRUD operations, balance tracking, and request status updates. The user-service manages employee profiles, manager relationships, and authentication context. A React-based web-app consumes both services to provide employee self-service and manager approval workflows.
requirements: Employees must be able to submit leave requests by selecting start and end dates
Employees must be able to view the status of their submitted leave requests
Employees must be able to view their current leave balance
Managers must be able to view pending leave requests from their direct reports
Managers must be able to approve or reject leave requests
The system must track which employees report to which managers
Leave balances must be updated when requests are approved
All services must expose a /health endpoint for readiness checks
Authentication context must identify whether a user is an employee or manager

components.name: user-service
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: User Service API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Manages employee profiles, manager relationships, and user context
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
  /users/{userId}:
    get:
      summary: Get user profile
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: User profile
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '404':
          description: User not found
  /users/{userId}/manager:
    get:
      summary: Get the manager of a user
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Manager details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
        '404':
          description: Manager not found
  /users/{userId}/reports:
    get:
      summary: Get direct reports for a manager
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of direct reports
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
components:
  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        email:
          type: string
        managerId:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        isManager:
          type: boolean
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a Go service using net/http listening on port 9090. Store user data in memory with a map. Seed initial data with at least 5 employees and 2 managers. Each employee record has id, name, email, managerId (nullable), and isManager flag. Provide endpoints: GET /health returns {"status":"ok"}. GET /users/{userId} returns the user object or 404. GET /users/{userId}/manager returns the manager object for the given user or 404 if no manager. GET /users/{userId}/reports returns an array of users whose managerId matches userId. Handle invalid userId gracefully with 404. Use JSON for all request and response bodies. Log all incoming requests with method and path.

components.name: leave-service
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Leave Service API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Manages leave requests, approvals, and balance tracking
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
  /leave-requests:
    post:
      summary: Submit a new leave request
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequestInput'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Leave request created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '400':
          description: Invalid input
    get:
      summary: List leave requests
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by employee userId
        - name: managerId
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
          description: Filter by manager userId to see pending requests for their reports
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of leave requests
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
  /leave-requests/{requestId}:
    get:
      summary: Get a single leave request
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave request details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '404':
          description: Request not found
    patch:
      summary: Update leave request status (approve/reject)
      parameters:
        - name: requestId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequestUpdate'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Request updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveRequest'
        '400':
          description: Invalid status transition
        '404':
          description: Request not found
  /leave-balance/{userId}:
    get:
      summary: Get leave balance for a user
      parameters:
        - name: userId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Leave balance
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LeaveBalance'
        '404':
          description: User not found
components:
  schemas:
    LeaveRequestInput:
      type: object
      required:
        - userId
        - startDate
        - endDate
      properties:
        userId:
          type: string
        startDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        endDate:
          type: string
          format: date
    LeaveRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        userId:
          type: string
        startDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        endDate:
          type: string
          format: date
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pending, approved, rejected]
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updatedAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    LeaveRequestUpdate:
      type: object
      required:
        - status
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [approved, rejected]
    LeaveBalance:
      type: object
      properties:
        userId:
          type: string
        totalDays:
          type: integer
        usedDays:
          type: integer
        remainingDays:
          type: integer
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a Go service using net/http listening on port 9090. Store leave requests and balances in memory. Each leave request has id (UUID), userId, startDate, endDate, status (pending/approved/rejected), createdAt, updatedAt. Initialize each user with 20 total leave days. POST /leave-requests accepts userId, startDate, endDate, creates a new request with status=pending, returns 201 with the created object. Validate that endDate >= startDate, return 400 otherwise. GET /leave-requests with query param userId returns all requests for that user. GET /leave-requests with query param managerId calls user-service at http://user-service:9090/users/{managerId}/reports to get direct report IDs, then returns all pending requests for those users. PATCH /leave-requests/{requestId} accepts status (approved or rejected). When approved, calculate days between startDate and endDate (inclusive), subtract from user's totalDays, update usedDays. Return 400 if insufficient balance. GET /leave-balance/{userId} returns totalDays, usedDays, remainingDays. GET /health returns {"status":"ok"}. Log all requests. Handle 404 for missing resources.

components.name: leave-web-app
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Leave Management Web App
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Frontend SPA for employee leave requests and manager approvals
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: App is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a React single-page application using TypeScript, Vite, and React Router. Serve the production build with a simple Node.js express server on port 8080. The app has three main views: Employee Dashboard, Manager Dashboard, and Leave Balance. Employee Dashboard: displays a form to submit a new leave request (start date, end date). On submit, POST to http://leave-service:9090/leave-requests with hardcoded userId. Below the form, fetch and display the user's leave requests from GET http://leave-service:9090/leave-requests?userId={userId}, showing status badges (pending/approved/rejected). Manager Dashboard: fetch direct reports from http://user-service:9090/users/{managerId}/reports, then fetch pending requests for those reports from http://leave-service:9090/leave-requests?managerId={managerId}. Display each request with Approve and Reject buttons that PATCH http://leave-service:9090/leave-requests/{requestId} with the chosen status. Leave Balance view: fetch from http://leave-service:9090/leave-balance/{userId} and display totalDays, usedDays, remainingDays. Use a simple navigation bar to switch between views. Hardcode a userId for demo purposes (e.g. user1 for employee, manager1 for manager view). Style with basic CSS or Tailwind. Implement error handling for failed API calls (show toast or alert). The express server serves static assets and has GET /health that returns {"status":"ok"}. Use environment variables or config to set backend URLs, defaulting to the service names above.
